title: Rezoning to allow housing at 629 West 54th Street, Manhattan
summary: This application would change the zoning map for property at 629 West 54th Street from an M2-4 district to a C4-7 district and establish a Special Hudson River Park District. Together with related zoning text and special permit applications, it would facilitate a mixed-use development with residential and commercial uses totaling about 506,000 square feet of floor area. The site is in Manhattan Community District 4.
